what: The full computer-use command issued through the console's operator on a real Windows 11 desktop (POST /api/cu/start, dry_run false, model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5), three attempts on 2026-09-21 between 02:39 and 02:53 local time, while the user was working on the same desktop. Each attempt is the run's status payload exactly as the page polled it; step rows are in the ledger under session_id = "<run_id>:<goal index>" (which=act), planning-model calls under session_id = run_id (which=cu_llm). hello.txt was not created by any attempt. Everything each attempt exposed was fixed in the same PR and has a regression test in tests/test_cu_runner.py or tests/test_cu_act.py.

attempts.name: before the fixes

goals: Type the text "hello world" into the Notepad editing area
Open the Save As dialog using Ctrl+S

Type "%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\hello.txt" into the file name field of the Save As dialog (this bypasses the need to navigate the folder tree) and click the Save button

exposed: key chords were not executed: SendInput sent 0 of 6 events — the INPUT union lacked MOUSEINPUT, so sizeof(INPUT) was wrong on x64 (fixed in jevskill/cu/act.py)

the user switched to Chrome mid-run; the loop observed Chrome and the model proposed the Windows key — the target window is now pinned by pid, observation and action refuse to act in another process (runner._ensure_target_in_front)
ten escalations in a row answered with an action that did not execute — three consecutive unexecuted escalation actions now end the goal

in the Save As dialog every Jev step was unknown_op: the 60-candidate cap dropped the file-name edit and the Save button and the region cascade found no region — the operator passes cap=150 (single decide: type file-name 0.91, click Save 0.94) and observes with a 1500 ms budget
